caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt with a grid of 49 square patches, arranged in seven rows and seven columns. Each patch contains a distinct, colorful design, including a variety of objects, symbols, and plant motifs. The predominant colors in the drawing are red, green, yellow, blue, and white, with each patch bordered and separated by gray lines simulating stitching. Examples of objects depicted include floral arrangements, laurel wreaths, a harp, an eagle, a shield with stars and stripes, a lion, a ship, an anchor, and geometric shapes. There are also symbols such as national flags, birds, a crown, and fruits. The overall background and fabric of the quilt are rendered in a pale gray with a pattern that gives the impression of textile texture. The border of the quilt is highlighted with a red outline, and some patches feature text or emblems within their designs. The objects are mostly centered in each square, with attention to detailed coloration and variety in motif placement. The artist's signature, "Fanny Traskin," is located in the bottom left corner.
title: Friendship Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
